label: Mid-original-phase input among e/b/l/s/h/z after an earlier h/x/o
explanation: Fires almost only during the original (input) phase: none at the delimiter, 9 copy-phase steps out of 12946. It is concentrated at positions t=3..6 (about 95% of activation mass, peaking at t=5) and never fires at t=0 or 1. Within that window it prefers inputs e, b, l, s, h, z (about 73% of mass) and sequences where h, x or o appeared earlier (prev_tok=h and prev2_tok=h give about 6-7x lift; first_tok=o gives 3.5x). The strongest examples are an e/b/l/s/f input shortly after an h. First occurrences of a token make up 81% of mass. The position window alone has 0.95 mass recall but only 4% precision, and the token conditions reach about 0.29 precision, so the gating is graded across token identities and history and is not one clean rule. Activations are weak (mean 0.016).
